{{Top|leg}}
'''Emergency Service Laws''' was a law document of the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]]. Article 11607 of the document allowed law enforcement officers to deputize the citizens of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for help during criminal investigations, and Article 101173 codified the salary allowance for those citizens.
